title: Clicking a deposit-locked Bill To shows an error toast with Open Deposits
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Approved, billed to customer B, holding one deposit of $10.00 taken on its Finance tab after customer B was picked.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Expand the Customer card.
  3. Click the Bill To field.
  4. Wait 10 seconds without clicking anything.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The Customer card's "Bill To" field reads customer B's name.

Step 3:

  • An error toast shows "This work order has a $10.00 deposit from [customer B's name]. Reverse it, change the Bill To, then take the deposit again under the new Bill To."
  • The toast has an "Open Deposits" button.
  • No list opens.

Step 4:

  • The toast fades away after 10 seconds.

Words in square brackets in a message stand for the value they name, such as customer B's name exactly as it is saved; every other word of the message must match exactly.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)
